English: Meeting Chamber
A simple gathering space, furnished with earthen benches and crude timber, where early settlers discuss matters of survival and defense.
Wisemens Hall
A timber-roofed hall where local sages and chiefs debate, offering modest administrative improvements and greater security.
Stone Assembly Room
A sturdier chamber built of rough stone, offering basic protection and a central place for local leaders to meet and organize.
Council Chamber
A fortified council hall, set with stone pillars and guarded doors, where the realms affairs are deliberated by trusted advisors.
Noble Gathering Hall
An imposing stone hall with banners and tapestries, designed to host noble assemblies, courtly events, and the occasional war council.
Firekeepers Hall
The heart of the keep, this radiant hall symbolizes unity and vigilance, where the eternal fire of leadership is tended and the realms destiny is forged.
Royal Audience Chamber
A grand, vaulted chamber richly decorated, where the lord receives petitioners, dispenses justice, and commands the loyalty of the realms elite.
Assembly House
A stately building where lords and trusted retainers gather to coordinate defense and governance, its influence felt throughout the domain.
Royal Hall
The castles crowning glory, this majestic hall is the stage for royal ceremonies, decrees, and great councils, its walls adorned with the symbols of the dynastys power.
Grand Audience House
A legendary seat of power, vast enough to gather all vassals and knights. Here, the rulers word echoes across the realm and the might of the dynasty is unmatched.
